preconditions.description: n is an integer between 1 and 50000 inclusive.
k is a non-negative integer such that 2k is at most n.

preconditions.expression: len(parts) == 2 and all(c.isdigit() or c.isspace() for c in line) and len([x for x in parts if x]) == 2
preconditions.description: The first line of stdin contains exactly two space-separated integers n and k.

postconditions.description: The output integers form a permutation of numbers from 1 to 2n.

postconditions.expression: sum(abs(a[2*i - 1] - a[2*i]) for i in range(1, n + 1)) - abs(sum(a[2*i - 1] - a[2*i] for i in range(1, n + 1))) == 2 * k
postconditions.description: The permutation satisfies the equation: sum of absolute differences of pairs minus absolute value of sum of differences equals 2k.
